handoff: Cause: the reserve (early cash timing). Change: starting_credits 1800 to 2100. Sim 200 seeds: decent 98% median 23. QA re-run requested.

details.cause: The reserve, through early cash and the ship-buy gate. v1 decent bought ship 3 at cycle 3 and ship 4 at cycle 4 (cash 100 after) and had 23 ships by cycle 29. v4 decent has cash 437-547 at cycle 3 and 442-858 at cycle 6, and buys ship 3 at cycle 7-10 and ship 4 at 8-14 (5-9 ships by cycle 30). The bot buys a ship only when cash >= ship_price (900), and with 3-4 routes the reserve (115 per route: trip 95 + upkeep 20) holds back 345-460 of that cash, and smaller Buys give less stock to sell, so cycle 3-6 income is lower. Four-cycle slip in ship 3 compounds. Not the ship cost (900 unchanged since v18), not upkeep, not route income timing in itself (settle order unchanged). v1 wins were marginal (cycles 27-29 of 30; sim says 23), so any lag of 3+ cycles turns 5/8 into 0/8.

changes.reason: +300 float offsets the reserve in cycles 1-6; one-off, no late-game scaling, no new key

also_tried_not_applied.starting_credits 2400: decent 100% median 22, mining 83% (too close to decent)

details.how_checked: Sim cannot show the reserve (no cash-settle model). I compared QA v1 and v4 per-run cash_by_cycle and ship_buys, and used the sim only to check that the +300 float does not break targets or make mining or always_expand dominant. Mining stays 4 cycles behind decent; always_expand still 0%.
details.qa_rerun_request: Seeds 1 to 8, fast clock, strategies decent, mining_focus, always_expand, same bot flags as v4. Must show: decent cash at cycle 3 above 900 or ship 3 bought by cycle 5 in at least 6 of 8 seeds; decent wins at least 5 of 8, at cycles 24-29; mining_focus wins fewer than decent; always_expand 0 of 8; warning streaks in mining runs fall (v4: 2-8 per run, 23-78 route-warn cycles). If decent is still under 4 of 8 with ship 3 on time, the cause is not the float and the next step is a reserve-aware sim model.
details.save_note: starting_credits applies to new games only; existing saves keep their cash.
